correctness.rationale: The finite unordered deleted-product cubical chain model for the 4-cube graph has 120 vertices, 448 one-cells and 400 two-cells, with signed ∂1∂2=0. Independently rebuilt all 132 disjoint coordinate square-pair torus chains and verified ∂2T=0. Exact elimination gives rank(∂2)=312 mod101 and rank(T)=88 mod2, forcing rational H2 rank 88. A newly chosen 88x88 torus-cell submatrix has exact determinant +1, proving the torus span saturated and equals ker∂2 integrally. Automorphisms give 24+12+96 orbits; Smith normal form on the unimodular torus basis has 82 unit and six 2 invariants for the 96 nonparallel orbit, and all unit invariants after adding either parallel orbit. These exact integer certificates prove the finite Q4 claim; raw verification logs alone were not relied upon.

value.rationale: The natural coordinate-square tori of the 4-cube yield an integral-vs-rational generation distinction: the full set integrally generates H2, but the nonparallel symmetry orbit has six independent parity obstructions repaired by either parallel orbit. This is a motivated exact integral lattice invariant invisible to ranks and a complete symmetry classification, not a randomly sliced finite test.

final_claim: H2(UConf2(|Q4|);Z) is Z^88 generated by 132 disjoint coordinate-face product tori; the 96 nonparallel orbit tori have quotient (Z/2)^6 and either parallel orbit saturates.
